results.check:
N1 [NO VELOCITY DISPERSION] a coherent field has exactly one velocity at
      each event, so its dispersion -- the second central moment, the only
      thing free-streaming consumes -- vanishes identically
results.measured: sigma^2: WDM(3.5 keV) = 2.0477e+03 m^2/s^2 ; Noether charge = 0.0000e+00 m^2/s^2

results.check:
N2 [NO FREE-STREAMING LENGTH] lambda_fs = int (sigma/a) dt = 0 for the
      charge, while WDM of every viable mass has a finite one
results.measured: lambda_fs: WDM(3.5 keV) = 0.6739 Mpc ; Noether charge = 0.0000 Mpc

results.check:
N3 [HYPERBOLIC, NOT VLASOV] the perturbation equation's characteristic
      speed is c_s, not a particle velocity; with c_s = 0 the cone
      collapses and there is no propagation at all
results.measured: characteristic speed = c_s = 0.0000e+00 m/s ; WDM particle speed = 4.5251e+01 m/s

results.check:
N4 [NO JEANS SCALE] with c_s = 0 the Jeans length is identically zero,
      so pressure cannot stabilise any mode on any scale

N5 [NO P(k) TURNOVER] the only non-circular scale a0 makes is
      r_M = sqrt(G M / a_0), which requires a mass: it is a per-object
      HALO scale, not a k-space turnover
results.measured: r_M spans 3.859 -> 1220.197 kpc as M spans 1e10 -> 1e15 Msun (2.50 decades in r for 5 in M)
results.threshold: r_M must depend on M (span > 1 decade) => no k-independent turnover exists

results.check:
N6 [THE SOUND SPEED IS HEALTHY] c_s^2 of the frozen scalar stays inside
      (0,1) on the whole physical branch -- the pre-registered falsifier
      'c_s^2 leaving [0,1] anywhere -> dead' is NOT triggered

N7 [c_s^2 = 0 IS A SECTOR INPUT, NOT A STATE OF f] the frozen scalar
      never has c_s^2 = 0: it is >= 1/2 for u >= 0 and strictly positive on
      the whole domain u > -1. The 'sound speed exactly zero' free dust must
      come from a sector with rho proportional to the charge, not from f.
results.threshold: for c_s^2 = 0 to be a state of f we would need min c_s^2 < 1e-3; measured 0.5 > 1e-3 => the statement 'it is an input' holds

results.check:
N8 [THE SCALAR FLUID IS JEANS-STABLE ON EVERY SUB-HORIZON SCALE]
      with c_s ~ 0.88 c the Jeans wavenumber exceeds the horizon
      wavenumber, so no sub-horizon mode of the k-essence fluid can grow

N9 [GROWTH IS SCALE-FREE] P(k,a)/P(k,a_i) = D(a)^2 is the same number at
      k = 0.1 and k = 100 h/Mpc: the transfer function is k-independent

N10 [THE KEPLER-GRADE DISCRIMINATOR] the framework predicts R(k) = 1 at
      EVERY k -- no cutoff, no break -- while a 3.5 keV thermal relic
      predicts R(100 h/Mpc) of order 1e-4

N11 [THE SLOPE] the framework's small-scale slope is exactly the LCDM
      slope -- n_eff -> n_s - 4 = -3.035 with the log running +2/ln(2.34 q)

N12 [NOT CIRCULAR] the prediction R(k) = 1 and its slope do not use the
      value of a_0 or of Lambda, and the one place a_0 could enter
      (the turnover scale) is precisely the H029-circular quantity
results.measured: a_0 appears only in: ['part2 (excluded as circular)']; c H_0/a_0 = [6.9947, 5.8058] = the postulate itself
results.threshold: a_0 and Lambda enter the R(k)=1 derivation 0 times, and the only a_0 scale is flagged circular
